notes.title: Recycling Center Simulator - Full game released!
notes.content:
Get ready to manage your own recycling center! ♻️

The waste is piling up, and it's your turn to sort and recycle. Set up your recycling lines, process materials, and watch your center thrive! 🚛

We’re proud to announce that Recycling Center Simulator is Now Available to Play! 🎊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928520/Recycling_Center_Simulator/

After months of hard work, Recycling Center Simulator is finally ready for you to enjoy! 💪 Our team has put in countless hours to make sure the game meets your expectations. Your feedback throughout development was crucial – we've taken your ideas and suggestions seriously. Thank you for being part of the journey! 🤝

We’d also like to give a huge thanks to our amazing community for all the support and excitement you've shown us – from the demo to the full release. Without your passion, we wouldn’t have been able to push ourselves to deliver the best experience possible. ❤️

Now, it’s time for you to take the lead and build the most efficient recycling center! 🌿 We hope you enjoy every moment of it.

Don’t miss out – you can also grab Recycling Center Simulator at a special launch discount or as part of our exclusive Bundles! 🎁

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45485/Recycling_Thief/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45486/Recycling_the_Car_Parts/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45636/Ship_Graveyard_Recycled/

Have fun!
Recycling Center Simulator Team

notes.title: Recycling Center Simulator: Prologue - is now available to play!
notes.content:
[b]We are happy to announce that the Recycling Center Simulator: Prologue is now available to play for free for everyone![/b] 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3110130/

Now you can open your own recycling center and run the business as you fit. This is just a small part of what awaits you in the full version of the game. 

We are looking forward to your opinions, feedback and ideas, which are crucial in the further development of the full version of the game. We really count on your feedback, you can do it on Community Hub or on our Discord server (links are available below 👇).

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3110130/discussions/]📖- Prologue Bugs & Feedbacks[/url]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/vJ8jGtCYyN]💬- Our Discord Server[/url]

[previewyoutube=cS50GAdX9ds;full][/previewyoutube]

Have fun! 
RCS Team 😊

notes.title: FREE PROLOGUE RELEASE DATE ANNOUCEMENT
notes.content:
[h3][b]We’re thrilled to officially announce the release date for the Recycling Centre Simulator: Prologue! 🤩 This free prologue will be available later this month, giving you a first-hand look at what’s in store for the full version of the game.[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]🗓️ Mark your calendars: August 23, 2024, at 3:00 PM CET![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3110130/Recycling_Center_Simulator_Prologue/

The Prologue is your perfect opportunity to dive into the world of recycling, explore the mechanics, and influence the development of the final game. We’re eagerly looking forward to hearing your thoughts, feedback, and ideas on how we can make the game even better. Your input is invaluable to us! 😊

Get ready to roll up your sleeves and start recycling like a pro! ♻️

See you soon 😊
Recycling Centre Simulator Team
